title: Mark as Unread inside an open thread that has only the person's own replies marks it, keeps the hold, and shows no toast
why: A thread with only the person's own replies has nothing countable, so the server (v1.21.38+) marks it (`markedUnread`, outcome `marked`); the hold stays while the person is there and no toast is shown. Decided by artin (#proj-mobile:966d7abd, 2026-10-29).

server: packages/server/src/routes/channels.ts (POST /channels/:id/unread: only own replies sets markedUnread, v1.21.38+)
